scope: Composed JavaScript race with original physics, AI, contacts, bonuses and timers. A test-only route follower supplies ordinary analog controls. No poses, velocities, triggers, pickups, timers, or physics tables are changed. This is not an original Windows full-process comparison or a full-campaign UI run.
startPolicy: Active starting grid, matching the existing matrix driving checks. No authored opening camera/countdown coverage is claimed. Constructor countdown:false; ordinary driver input from first25ms tick, no live phase or timer writes.
testDriverPolicy: Globally fixed closed original road-node line with recorded turn penalty and nodes; look-ahead starts from projection onto the chosen lane segment rather than the road center; recorded later corner windows use private closed-loop scalar forecasts and ordinary steering/throttle/brake; detour planner disabled; production obstacles and collision responses remain active. Ordinary inputs only.
